subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit + MRC floor modification — CloudNova pilot
messages:
From: Thomas Grant <t.grant@cloudnova.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot proposal — request for onboarding credit + MRC floor

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. CloudNova is excited to pilot Redwood for a targeted set of inference workloads (search re-rank + customer summarization). We reviewed the initial commercial proposal and have two asks to get internal procurement to greenlight the pilot: 

1) A one-time onboarding credit to cover professional services and migration support (we're requesting a 20% credit off the first 6 months of committed spend).
2) A temporary reduction to the MRC minimum floor during the 6-month pilot (move floor from $60k/mo to $25k/mo for the pilot period).

Both are one-off asks tied to the pilot. If we can agree, procurement will route for PO and we can target a September start.

Attached: CloudNova_internal_requirements.pdf (internal summary)

Can you confirm what flexibility you have here or if we need to escalate?

Best,
Thomas
Thomas Grant
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudNova
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Grant <t.grant@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot proposal — request for onboarding credit + MRC floor

Thomas —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. I attached an updated SOW and a short exception memo template to speed approvals. High level: we can consider a one-time onboarding credit and a pilot floor adjustment but both require commercial exception approval due to material variance from standard packaging.

Ben/Marissa — looping you both to request internal approval routing. Key commercial points:
- Proposed credit: 20% off invoice credits applied across first 6 months (approx $84k credit).
- Pilot MRC floor: $25k/mo for 6 months, reverting to standard $60k/mo after pilot.
- Company: CloudNova; estimated committed ARR if converted to annual: ~$1.3M.
- Risk: lowering the floor increases collection/commit risk; finance will want an escrow/PO cadence.

Attachments: CloudNova_SOW_v1.pdf; onboarding-credit-memo.docx (draft exception memo).

Request: Ben/Marissa — can you review and confirm whether you can approve or if I should route to Lauren for VP/CFO signoff? They need a yes/no by EOD Monday to hold the September start.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot proposal — request for onboarding credit + MRC floor

Monica — thanks for the packet. I reviewed the numbers quickly; this is a strategic target account in the financial services vertical with strong logos and partnership potential. I'm inclined to greenlight the exception with the following controls:

- Approve a one-time onboarding credit up to 20% provided CloudNova signs a 12-month conversion commitment if the pilot converts within 9 months.
- Approve temporary floor at $25k/mo for 6 months only.
- Require PO or upfront deposit for the first 2 months, and milestone deliverables tied to onboarding credit release.

Marissa/Lauren — tagging you for finance/legal approval and to confirm the paperwork required (escrow/PO terms). I've attached a draft exception worksheet with ARR impact and downside sensitivity.

Attachment: commercial-exception-worksheet.xlsx

Ben Carter
VP, Enterprise Sales
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot proposal — request for onboarding credit + MRC floor

Team — I did a quick finance run and have three outstanding items before I can sign off / recommend CFO approval:

1) Confirmed sketch of conversion mechanics (what counts as a conversion, minimum committed ARR if they convert).
2) Contractual language for credit clawback if pilot doesn't convert by month 9.
3) Evidence of PO cadence or payment security for first 60 days (we should not accept open 30/60 without PO).

If we get (1)-(3) I recommend Lauren give conditional signoff. Monica — please work with CloudNova to get a firm PO commitment for the initial months and have Legal draft a short clawback clause (we can reuse language from DN-2026-042).

Looping Lauren for final VP/CFO signoff.

Marissa Cole
Finance, Commercial Operations
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot proposal — request for onboarding credit + MRC floor

Thanks all — I read the packet and Ben/Marissa's notes. I will approve the commercial exception on the conditions below: 

Conditions for VP/CFO signoff (approved if met):
- CloudNova provides a signed PO covering months 1-2 at the reduced floor ($25k x 2).
- Legal inserts a clawback clause: onboarding credit recouped pro rata if no conversion to minimum ARR of $900k within 9 months.
- Finance will hold the onboarding credit as an invoice credit to be applied after milestone acceptance (onboarding milestones defined in SOW).

If Monica can get the PO and Legal drafts the clause, I authorize the exception memo to be finalized and to proceed to DocuSign. Please attach the PO and updated SOW to the HubSpot deal record when complete.

Lauren Bishop
SVP, Finance (acting CFO)
Redwood Inference
